subject: Re: Lake District Health — demo timing and onboarding prerequisites
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@lakedistricthealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lakedistricthealth.org, Ellen Pierce <ellen.pierce@lakedistricthealth.org>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: live demo for Lake District Health (June 24)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We'd like to schedule a live demo for the team on Thursday, June 24 at 10:00 AM PT to evaluate Redwood for clinical-routing/QA use cases. Attendees will include procurement, security, and two clinical informaticists.

Before we lock the slot, procurement needs the vendor intake packet completed (NDA, security questionnaire, and supplier risk form). I'm attaching our intake form (blank) so you can see what they'll ask. Can you confirm whether Redwood can complete the questionnaire directly, or if you prefer we provide a filled copy and NDA for signature?

If the demo can't happen on the 24th because of intake gating, please propose two alternative windows the following week. We're trying to get execs off the calendar quickly.

Thanks —
Sanjay Rao
Director, IT Procurement
Lake District Health
Attachment: LDH_vendor_intake_form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@lakedistricthealth.org>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: live demo for Lake District Health (June 24)

Hi Sanjay —

Appreciate the context and the intake form. We definitely want to get the demo in front of your team, but a few gating items on our side typically need to be completed before a live technical walkthrough with security and procurement present:

- Signed mutual NDA (we can sign one you provide or send our standard)
- Completed security questionnaire (we can pre-fill most sections but need the final supplier attestation from you for some org-specific items)
- IDP/SSO metadata (if you want an SSO-enabled demo) and any SCIM provisioning notes

Also worth noting: Monica (our lead solutions engineer) will be traveling June 24–25 and is the best person to run the session for the clinical use cases you described. Markus (cc'd) will join for any commercial/exec questions.

Would it be acceptable to move the demo to the week of June 28? We have availability: Tuesday June 29 at 9:00 AM PT or Thursday July 1 at 11:00 AM PT (Monica returns June 26). If procurement can push a signed NDA and the filled questionnaire by EOD June 23 we can aim for the 29th. Otherwise July 1 gives a bit more breathing room.

I'm attaching a short Redwood vendor checklist to show the exact artifacts we request — NDA, SOC2 reference, questionnaire, and SSO hints. If you prefer we complete the questionnaire and send it back for your review, we can do that as well; it typically takes us a day once we have the org-specific bits.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please send the NDA (or approve our standard)
2) Indicate whether you'd like us to pre-fill the questionnaire or receive a completed version
3) Confirm a preferred demo window from the two options above

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_vendor_checklist.md (text/markdown)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@lakedistricthealth.org>, procurement@lakedistricthealth.org
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: live demo for Lake District Health (June 24)

Hi all —

Thanks Neha. I'm aligned with the ask — reschedule the live walkthrough to when Monica is back and intake docs are completed. If Lake District can get the NDA and questionnaire in by the 23rd, the June 29 slot at 9:00 AM PT works for us; otherwise let's target June 30 at 9:00 AM PT as a second choice.

Operational notes: if procurement needs an exec-level overview ahead of the technical session, I'm happy to do a 20-minute call on June 25 (asynchronous of course) — but that call should not replace the technical walkthrough. Also we can deliver a short recorded walkthrough to keep momentum if scheduling remains tight.

Markus
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@lakedistricthealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lakedistricthealth.org, Ellen Pierce <ellen.pierce@lakedistricthealth.org>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: live demo for Lake District Health (June 24)

Neha/Markus —

Thanks for the clear next steps. Procurement has expedited the review and I attached the signed NDA to this message. We're also completing the security questionnaire now — expect the filled file and IDP metadata by EOD Wednesday, June 23.

Given that, we can do June 30 at 9:00 AM PT (Markus's fallback) — that timing works for our security lead. Please go ahead and send a calendar invite for June 30 9:00 AM PT and include dial-in + a link to any pre-read materials. If Monica would prefer July 1 for the clinical folks, say so and we can accommodate, but June 30 is fine.

Appreciate the patience — happy to get this on the books.

Sanjay Rao
Director, IT Procurement
Lake District Health
Attachment: LDH_signed_NDA.pdf (application/pdf)
